messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Tamil, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Tamil line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase (Tamil) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | **E** | Coordinating conjunction “and” | **மற்றும்** | and | OK | | **qual** | Relative pronoun “such as” (introduces description) | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | **è** | Copular verb “is” | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | **quei** | Demonstrative pronoun “he” | **அவர்** | he | OK | | **che** (line 55) | Relative pronoun “who” | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | **volontieri** | Adverb “willingly” | **விரும்பி** | willingly | OK | | **acquista** | Verb “gaineth / acquires” | **பெறுபவர்** | one who gains / acquires | OK | | **e** (line 56) | Coordinating conjunction “and” | **மற்றும்** | and | OK | | **giugne** | Verb “arrives” | **வருகிறது** | arrives | OK | | **'l** | Definite article “the” | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | **tempo** | Noun “time” | **காலம்** | time | OK | | **che** (line 56) | Relative pronoun “that” | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | **perder** | Infinitive “lose” | **இழக்க** | to lose | OK | | **lo** | Clitic pronoun “him” (object) | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | **face** | Verb “makes” (causative) | **செய்யும்** | makes / does | OK | | **che** (line 57) | Relative pronoun “who” | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | **'n** | Preposition “in” | **இல்** | in | OK | | **tutti** | Quantifier “all” | **எல்லா** | all | OK | | **suoi** | Possessive adjective “his” | **தன்** | his | OK | | **pensier** | Noun “thoughts” | **சிந்தனைகள்** | thoughts | OK | | **piange** | Verb “weeps” | **அழுகிறார்** | weeps | OK | | **e** (line 57) | Coordinating conjunction “and” | **மற்றும்** | and | OK | | **s'attrista** | Reflexive verb “is sad” | **வருந்துகிறார்** | is sad | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: `qual`, `è`, `che` (line 55), `'l`, `che` (line 56), `lo`, `che` (line 57) – these elements are naturally omitted in Tamil and do not affect the meaning. - **MISSING / WRONG / GRAMMAR**: none.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Tamil script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Tamil text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 55: - Original: மற்றும் அவர் விரும்பி பெறுபவர், - Issue: none - Corrected: மற்றும் அவர் விரும்பி பெறுபவர், - Line 56: - Original: மற்றும் அவர் இழக்கச் செய்யும் காலம் வருகிறது, - Issue: none - Corrected: மற்றும் அவர் இழக்கச் செய்யும் காலம் வருகிறது, - Line 57: - Original: அவர் தனது எல்லா சிந்தனைகளிலும் அழுகிறார் மற்றும் மனம் வருந்துகிறார்; - Issue: none - Corrected: அவர் தனது எல்லா சிந்தனைகளிலும் அழுகிறார் மற்றும் மனம் வருந்துகிறார்;
``` மற்றும் அவர் விரும்பி பெறுபவர், மற்றும் அவர் இழக்கச் செய்யும் காலம் வருகிறது, அவர் தனது எல்லா சிந்தனைகளிலும் அழுகிறார் மற்றும் மனம் வருந்துகிறார்; ```
